pages.text: Wants a room: walls, a floor and a ceiling, with no way out to the sky. At least 27 blocks of space.$(p)Grants:$(li)Soul Step, growing with the tier, up to +6.$(p)Tiers begin at a score of 6.

Will not count without:$(li)4 of Block of Amethyst or Budding Amethyst$(p)Rewards, most first:$(li)Budding Amethyst$(li)Ender Chest$(li)Crying Obsidian$(li)Block of Amethyst$(li)End Rod$(p)Counts against it:$(li)$(l:soulhome:multiblocks/tags#bookshelves)any bookshelves$(/l)$(li)$(l:soulhome:multiblocks/tags#smithing)any smithing$(/l)$(li)any crops
pages.title: What counts

pages.text: None of this is required, but building it well earns more than the blocks alone:$(li)Frame surrounds resonance, or conduit sits over resonance, or frame forms a closed circuit.
pages.title: How you arrange it

pages.text: What those parts are:$(li)Frame: Obsidian or Crying Obsidian$(li)Resonance: Block of Amethyst or Budding Amethyst$(li)Conduit: End Rod
